lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a staggered grid pattern along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular spot centroids to form a discernible lattice structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge feature situated on the upper third of the visible flank, displaying a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a light dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch is present on the posterior trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A thin, elongated dark silhouette is visible immediately ventral to the pectoral fin, and intense caustic light refraction patterns are overlaid across the central body region.
